title: podagrostis rosei
intro: Podagrostis rosei, commonly known as Chinese Needle Grass, is a type of plant native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which make it effective in alleviating coughs, bronchitis, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Chinese Needle Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
